verdict.rationale: The docs say you can point the OpenAI SDK at OpenRouter as a drop-in replacement, and the probe confirms a published OpenAPI spec usable for client generation. The docs also offer an interactive Request Builder that generates requests in many languages, and an agent migration skill implies SDK import updates. None of this explicitly documents a first-party OpenRouter SDK package, so building against official SDKs is only indirectly supported. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented first-party OpenRouter SDK, multi-language SDK coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.
